definition: Henrik Iskov Christensen (born July 16, 1962 in Frederikshavn, Denmark) is a Danish roboticist and Professor of Computer Science at Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, at the UC San Diego Jacobs School of Engineering.
details: He is also the Director of the Contextual Robotics Institute at UC San Diego. Before UC San Diego, he was a Distinguished Professor of Computer Science in the School of Interactive Computing at the Georgia Institute of Technology. At Georgia Tech, Christensen served as the founding director of the Institute for Robotics and Intelligent Machines (IRIM@GT) and the KUKA Chair of Robotics. Previously, Christensen was the Founding Chairman of European Robotics Research Network (EURON) and an IEEE Robotics and Automation Society Distinguished Lecturer in Robotics.

explainer.lead: Henrik I. Christensen is a Danish roboticist and professor. His work spans robotics, informatics and computer science.

contributions.name: He performs research on robotics, computer vision, and artificial intelligence and has published more than 400 contributions at major conferences and journals.
